# Fox Brothers & Co Ltd

Fox Brothers & Co Ltd is a Textile Manufacturing company. Fox Brothers & Co Ltd is a company that specializes in British flannel and fine cloth. They have been weaving fine cloth since 1772 and are known for their tailoring with heritage and provenance. Fox Brothers & Co Ltd employs 15 people, founded in 1772. Headquartered in United Kingdom, with offices in Wellington and Somerset. Its workforce is distributed across United Kingdom, France, and Pakistan.

## About

For more than two centuries Fox Brothers has produced woollen and worsted cloth in Wellington, Somerset, England. In 1772 the young Thomas Fox became a partner in his grandfather Thomas Were’s serge cloth making business and transformed the existing cottage industry into one of the most successful family-owned cloth manufacturers in Britain.
In recent years Fox Brothers has been growing and expanding the business with its highly skilled workforce and is continually developing ideas, mastering new machinery and processes.

Fox Brothers continues its 250 years’ tradition as a unique and iconic British textile manufacturer supplying outstanding natural wool cloth of the highest quality to a discerning worldwide customer base.
